bio.text: Cindy Carlson represents Idaho Senate District 7 and lives in Riggins; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term and a business owner occupation.

The legislature biography says Carlson graduated from Salmon River High School in Riggins and has 42 years of business experience founding multiple businesses with husband Guy, including logging, trucking, ranching and tourism.
The biography also lists service on the Grangeville school board and as founding chair of the Salmon River Joint School District #243 board.
